summary: Iteration 10 testing completed for 3 new features: Invoice/Agreement System, Auto Logout (30 min), and Motivational Popup. Backend: 10/10 tests passed. Frontend: All features working. Fixed bug in Invoices.js where orders.find was failing due to incorrect API response handling.

backend: POST /api/orders/{order_id}/generate-invoice?invoice_type=customer - generates customer invoice with all fields
POST /api/orders/{order_id}/generate-invoice?invoice_type=carrier - generates carrier invoice with carrier-specific fields
PUT /api/invoices/{invoice_id} - superadmin can edit invoices (role check working)
POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/sign - signs invoice with signature data and signer name
GET /api/invoices - returns invoices with invoice_type, customer_name fields
Invoice terms populated - Customer invoice has VEHICLE TRANSPORT AGREEMENT
Invoice terms populated - Carrier invoice has CARRIER DISPATCH AGREEMENT
COD calculation - correctly calculates total_price - deposit_amount
Invalid order returns 404 for invoice generation
frontend: Motivational Popup - appears after login with random quote
Motivational Popup - shows 'Daily Motivation' header and category
Motivational Popup - shows 'Breamway' branding
Motivational Popup - close button (X) works correctly
Order Detail - Customer Invoice button present and working
Order Detail - Carrier Invoice button present and working
Customer Invoice page - Professional Breamway header (blue gradient)
Customer Invoice page - Customer Information section (Name, Email, Phone, Address)
Customer Invoice page - Vehicle Information section (Year, Make, Model, Type, VIN, Color, Condition)
Customer Invoice page - Route Information (Pickup/Delivery with all fields)
Customer Invoice page - Pricing & Payment section (Deposit, COD, Total, Payment Method)
Customer Invoice page - Terms & Conditions textarea with default terms
Customer Invoice page - Customer Signature section with canvas
Carrier Invoice page - Carrier Information section (Name, MC, Phone, Email, Driver)
Carrier Invoice page - Customer Reference section
Carrier Invoice page - Carrier Pay & COD section
Carrier Invoice page - Carrier/Driver Signature section
Invoices List - Type column with Customer/Carrier badges
Invoices List - Customer/Carrier name column
Invoices List - View, Mark Paid, Edit action buttons
Invoice Detail - Back, Print, Save buttons working
Session Timeout - AuthContext has 30 min INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT configured
Session Timeout - Tracks mousedown, keydown, scroll, touchstart, click, mousemove events
Session Timeout - Sets sessionExpired flag on timeout
Login page - Session expired message element present (data-testid='session-expired-msg')

critical_code_review_comments: Invoice generation correctly auto-populates all fields from order data
Customer vs Carrier invoices have different default terms (VEHICLE TRANSPORT vs CARRIER DISPATCH)
Invoice numbers use proper prefixes: INV-CUS for customer, INV-CAR for carrier
Signature pad implementation uses canvas with touch support
Session timeout correctly implemented with 30 minute inactivity timer
Motivational popup uses justLoggedIn state to show only once per login

bug_fixed.issue: orders.find is not a function - TypeError in getOrderForInvoice
bug_fixed.root_cause: getOrders() API returns {orders: [...], total: ...} but code was setting ordersRes.data directly instead of ordersRes.data.orders
bug_fixed.fix: Changed setOrders(ordersRes.data) to setOrders(ordersRes.data.orders || []) and setQuotes(quotesRes.data) to setQuotes(quotesRes.data.quotes || [])

seed_data_creation: Multiple test invoices created during backend testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 tested 3 new features: 1) Invoice/Agreement System - Customer and Carrier invoices can be generated from Order Detail page, each with professional Breamway branding, editable fields, terms & conditions, and digital signature pad. Invoices list shows Type column with Customer/Carrier badges. 2) Auto Logout - 30 minute inactivity timeout implemented in AuthContext.js, tracks user activity events and logs out with sessionExpired flag. 3) Motivational Popup - Shows random sales/transport quote after login, auto-dismisses after 30 seconds, can be manually closed. Fixed bug in Invoices.js where API response handling was incorrect.

auto_logout.session_expired_flag: sessionExpired state set to true on timeout
auto_logout.login_page_message: Session expired message shown via data-testid='session-expired-msg'
